title: ATR is a critical dependency gene for uveal melanoma
task: Identify and validate ATR as a therapeutic vulnerability in uveal melanoma
key_results: ATR inhibition with VE-822 reduced colony and spheroid formation across risk-stratified UM models; combination with paclitaxel showed significant synergy in blocking mitotic progression
comments: The dependency on ATR appears mechanistically tied to mitotic checkpoint control rather than general DNA repair, which is notable for rational drug combination design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Successful S phase completion and mitotic progression are critical for UM cell survival when ATR is inhibited
hypotheses.result: RNA-seq and functional studies confirmed mitotic progression as key determinant of ATR inhibitor response; synergy observed with paclitaxel supports this

title: Sitravatinib combined with osimertinib overcomes acquired osimertinib resistance in NSCLC by targeting AXL and the PI3K/AKT/GSK3β signaling pathway
task: Overcome acquired osimertinib resistance in EGFR-mutant NSCLC via dual kinase inhibition
key_results: Sitravatinib plus osimertinib showed markedly reinforced anti-tumor activity in vitro and in vivo compared to single agents; suppressed AXL and PI3K/AKT/GSK3β signaling and reversed epithelial–mesenchymal transition
comments: The mechanism elegantly identifies AXL as a bypass pathway for osimertinib resistance, though the clinical efficacy and safety profile remain to be validated in prospective trials.

hypotheses.hypothesis: AXL and PI3K/AKT/GSK3β signaling mediate osimertinib resistance; dual inhibition can overcome this resistance
hypotheses.result: Sitravatinib combined with osimertinib suppressed both AXL and downstream PI3K/AKT/GSK3β cascade, reversing EMT and restoring anti-tumor activity

title: Multimodal radiomic and foundation-model MRI features converge on basal ganglia patterns in Parkinson’s motor subtypes
task: Discriminating Parkinson's disease motor subtypes via multimodal MRI representations
key_results: Radiomic features outperformed foundation-model embeddings (AUC 0.664 vs 0.592); FLAIR+SWI radiomics combined with clinical scores achieved AUC 0.79±0.10; basal ganglia regions identified as discriminative
comments: Radiomics showed superior performance to transformer embeddings in this pilot, but the modest overall AUC suggests motor subtype classification remains challenging even with multimodal data.

model_io.model: Multiple ML classifiers with nested cross-validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multimodal MRI representations can discriminate TD and PIGD motor phenotypes
hypotheses.result: Radiomic features combined with clinical scores achieved AUC 0.79; basal ganglia circuitry (striatum, pallidum) drove discrimination

title: Development and comparison of machine learning-based clinical diagnostic models for girls with suspected central precocious puberty
task: Machine learning-based pre-screening for central precocious puberty diagnosis
key_results: CatBoost achieved AUROC 0.894 with ECE 0.059; could avoid 63 unnecessary GnRH tests per 100 cases while maintaining 84% sensitivity and 94.8% NPV
comments: Strong practical utility for reducing invasive testing, though external validation on independent cohorts would strengthen clinical translation claims.

model_io.model: CatBoost and four other ML classifiers (LR, RF, XGB, DNN)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Machine learning models can reduce unnecessary invasive GnRH stimulation testing in CPP diagnosis
hypotheses.result: CatBoost model achieved 63 test reduction per 100 cases with acceptable sensitivity trade-off

title: Comprehensive analysis of the prognosis of gastric cancer on the basis of three disulfidptosis-related lncRNA signatures
task: Prognostic signature development for gastric cancer using disulfidptosis-related lncRNAs
key_results: Three independent prognostic signatures established with C-index >0.6 and 1/3/5-year AUC >0.6; Signature 3 showed marginally superior performance; identified seven drugs with predicted differential sensitivity (AZD6738, BMS-345541, dabrafenib, etc.)
comments: Comprehensive computational framework with robust multi-screening strategy, but authors appropriately acknowledge all findings are in silico and require experimental validation before clinical application.

model_io.model: Three independent Cox regression-based prognostic models (Signatures 1-3)
Immune correlation and drug sensitivity analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disulfidptosis-related lncRNAs can stratify GC patient prognosis
hypotheses.result: Three signatures with C-index >0.6 and significant survival differences; associated with TMB, M2 macrophages, mast cells, and focal adhesion pathway

title: An integrated graph neural network and structure-based workflow for the discovery of allosteric PCSK9 inhibitors
task: Discovery of allosteric PCSK9 inhibitors via GNN and structure-based modeling
key_results: GNN model achieved R²=0.949 on test set; Ligand40 showed favorable binding energetics; Ligand42 demonstrated stable interactions suitable for prioritization
comments: Excellent integration of machine learning with physics-based validation, though identified hits remain computational predictions requiring experimental validation for PCSK9 drug development.

model_io.model: Message-passing graph neural network trained on PCSK9 ligands

hypotheses.hypothesis: GNN coupled with physics-based simulations can identify novel allosteric PCSK9 inhibitors
hypotheses.result: Framework identified Ligand42 as prioritized candidate with stable allosteric interaction patterns and favorable binding dynamics

title: An efficient ternary full adder design using carry-free ternary half adder and threshold detectors
task: Ternary full adder design using CNTFETs with carry-free half adder architecture
key_results: TFA achieves 103.9 ps delay, 1.02 µW power, 0.11 fJ PDP, and 10.96 fJ·ps EDP with 38 transistors; PDP improvements of 1.64–6.09× and EDP improvements of 2.20–11.59× over existing designs
comments: HSPICE simulation with 32-nm CNTFET model shows strong PVT robustness, but practical CNTFET fabrication challenges and scalability to larger circuits remain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Threshold detectors with chirality-tuned CNTs reliably decode sum into three levels (0, VDD/2, VDD)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; carry-free half adder + successor circuit achieves superior delay/power metrics under PVT variations

title: A feature-centric predictive and sensitivity analysis framework for bio-oil yield assessment in biomass pyrolysis
task: Feature-centric predictive and sensitivity analysis for biomass pyrolysis bio-oil yield
key_results: Regression model achieves test-stage R² > 0.91 with consistent low prediction errors; working temperature and volatile content identified as key yield drivers via sensitivity analysis
comments: Integrated framework combining feature selection, prediction, and sensitivity analysis is methodologically sound; agreement between methods validates interpretability, though domain-specific to pyrolysis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Feature screening reduces multicollinearity and improves both predictive accuracy and interpretability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; R² > 0.91 with concordant sensitivity analysis scores across methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temperature and volatile content dominate yield variation, while H and O show condition-dependent effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via global sensitivity analysis and feature attribution methods

title: A lightweight image encryption scheme using LFSR, logistic map, and cellular automata for resource-constrained devices
task: Lightweight image encryption for resource-constrained IoT devices
key_results: Combined LFSR, logistic map, and cellular automata achieves secure encryption with reduced computational complexity suitable for embedded systems
comments: Design targets IoT/embedded constraints but lacks quantitative performance metrics (throughput, memory usage) and formal cryptographic security analysis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Minor input variations cause significant encrypted image changes (avalanche effect)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; logistic map permutation and CA Rule 90 diffusion create desired diffusion property

title: Efficient retrieval-augmented generation via multi-signal token compression
task: Token compression for efficient retrieval-augmented generation
key_results: HLLC achieves moderate compression of retrieved contexts while retaining substantial proportion of exact-match accuracy on RACE and QuALITY benchmarks
comments: Indexing-time compression is practical and reusable, but evaluation restricted to multiple-choice QA and comprehensive reasoning-chain preservation remains unverified.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Indexing-stage compression avoids repeated query-time overhead without retraining retriever
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; compressed index reusable across queries on open-weight LLMs

title: Expectation and acoustic neural network representations enhance music identification from brain activity
task: EEG-based music identification using acoustic and expectation-related neural representations
key_results: Combined acoustic and expectation ANN representations outperform non-pretrained baselines; complementary gains exceed strong seed ensembles on EEG music recognition tasks
comments: Grounding neural decoding in dual cortical representations is promising, though evaluation limited to music domain and scalability to other tasks remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distinguishing acoustic vs. expectation representations improves downstream EEG recognition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pretrained models outperform baselines and combining representations yields complementary gains

title: Deep learning model cascade in electromyography decoding for gesture classification
task: sEMG-based gesture classification via cascaded Transformer-CA-BiLSTM deep learning
key_results: Cascaded model achieves 81.96% overall accuracy and 0.82 weighted F1 on NinaPro DB5, with individual gestures reaching 96.55%; outperforms individual components with 0.20M parameters
comments: Hierarchical temporal-channel attention fusion is effective for fine-grained gestures, but modest parameter advantage and limited cross-dataset validation suggest domain specificity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synergistic integration of Transformer (global dependencies), CA (channel recalibration), and BiLSTM (bidirectional dynamics) improves fine gesture recognition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; combined model outperforms individual components on NinaPro DB5 and BandMyo datasets

title: A robust road defect detection method for UAV imagery based on synergistic attention and adaptive feature refinement
task: Road defect detection in UAV imagery via enhanced YOLO architecture
key_results: URD-YOLOv11n achieves mAP@0.5 of 82.9% and mAP@0.5:0.95 of 53.0%, improvements of 5.1% and 4.3% over baseline
comments: Four complementary attention and loss innovations address practical UAV challenges (scale variation, low resolution, shadows), though evaluation limited to drone-specific datasets.

outputs: road defect bounding boxes and classifications

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial-Channel Synergistic Attention and Dynamic Upsampling improve fine-grained defect feature extraction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; synergistic approach reduces missed and false detections on low-resolution images

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wasserstein Distance Loss improves localization of small and blurred defects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; notable mAP gains over baseline with maintained lightweight inference

title: Evolutionary game study on green finance promoting low-carbon production in manufacturing enterprises under the industrial internet platform
task: Evolutionary game analysis of green finance and digital empowerment for low-carbon manufacturing
key_results: Digital empowerment costs, green lending rates, and initial strategic choices substantially influence equilibrium outcomes; effective digital platforms and financial incentives reinforce low-carbon adoption
comments: Three-party game-theoretic model provides qualitative insights into policy interactions, but lacks empirical validation and sensitivity to real industry parameters.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Digital empowerment costs and green credit returns shape enterprise low-carbon production adoption
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dynamic simulations show initial choices and parameter values drive long-term equilibrium states

title: Phase-based self-balancing strategy and performance evaluation of a compact K-H-V planetary vibratory mixer under 43 g high-frequency excitation
task: Develop and validate a compact K-H-V planetary vibratory mixer with phase-based self-balancing for high-frequency concrete mixing
key_results: Mixer achieved 28-day compressive strength of 53.9 MPa in 80 s, representing 31.5% improvement over conventional twin-shaft mixer; simulated dominant excitation frequency 75.08 Hz matches theoretical 75.26 Hz
comments: The kinematic-dynamic coupling model is sophisticated, but the 80 s mixing window is significantly accelerated compared to standard curing times, raising questions about long-term durability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Theoretical kinematic model accurately predicts actual excitation frequency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: theoretical 75.26 Hz closely matched simulated 75.08 Hz (0.24% error)

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-frequency vibration improves aggregate dispersion and ITZ behavior in concrete
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 31.5% compressive strength improvement and improved fracture morphology observed

title: Lightweight PMMA-based hybrid composites reinforced with Bi2O3 and B4C for advanced radiation shielding
task: Design and validate lightweight composite materials for dual gamma-ray and neutron radiation shielding
key_results: PMMA/Bi2O3/B4C composites achieved optimal gamma attenuation with highest filler concentration; simulated linear attenuation coefficients matched experimental measurements; neutron attenuation improved with increasing B4C content
comments: Monte Carlo validation via two independent codes (MCNP6 and Geant4) strengthens credibility, though neutron performance assessment relied solely on simulation without experimental neutron source validation.

inputs: composite samples with varying filler concentrations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increasing filler (Bi2O3/B4C) concentration enhances radiation shielding performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: highest filler concentration sample exhibited best gamma attenuation and improved neutron shielding

hypotheses.hypothesis: Monte Carlo simulations accurately predict experimental gamma attenuation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: simulated coefficients showed excellent agreement with experimental measurements
